qualifications: GFF coefficients and SRI curvature are supplied project results, not independently rederived here.
The SRI coefficient retains its source's formal analytic-MS/global-subtraction qualification.
The classical action is exact for the critical real saddle; nearest complex Borel singularity and renormalized prefactor power are conditional.
The 1d instanton amplitude is not used in 2d.
Sensitivity envelopes and coefficient allowances are not confidence intervals.
C0 through C7 retain their previous higher-precision sources; noisy lower-order cross-checks in the C8 campaign do not replace them. No joint covariance between retained campaigns is assumed.

C8_provenance.allowance_status: Empirical reporting allowance, not sampling SE or a confidence interval; adopted after production.
